values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. The registering camper must be 18 or older.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/westcott-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=468 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 146 campsites; of 142 read, all back-in: 12 listed at 50 ft, 49 at 40 ft, 9 at 35 ft, 55 at 30 ft, 3 at 25 ft, 14 at 20 ft. Plus 8 cottages and a group site. The Plateau loop has the Lake Ontario overlook.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/westcott-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=468 ('Campsite (146)', 'Cottage (8)'; 'A spectacular view of Lake Ontario can be seen from the overlook near the plateau camping area') + ReserveAmerica site list ('50 Back-In' 12, '40 Back-In' 49, '35 Back-In' 9, '30 Back-In' 55, '25 Back-In' 3, '20 Back-In' 14), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 74 of the 142 sites read have electric: 36 at 30 amp (Main Road, Back 10, Lake Road), 37 at 20 amp and one at 15 amp (almost all Plateau). No full hookups.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 468 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 36, '20 amp' 37, '15 amp' 1, 'Electric Hookup - no' 68, 'Full Hookup - no' 142), read 2026-10-21
